item.title: NAACP Image Awards celebrate Black excellence as Michael B Jordan and Delroy Lindo get standing ovation
item.description: Host Deon Cole opened the NAACP Image Awards with sharp jokes while showing support for Michael B Jordan and Delroy Lindo after a racist incident at the BAFTAs. The night became a powerful celebration of Black excellence in Hollywood.

item.title: Holi 2026: Easy tricks to remove stubborn colours from white clothes
item.description: Holi is all about vibrant celebrations, but those stubborn colour stains can leave your favourite outfits looking ruined. Before you give up on them, discover smart and effective solutions that can make a real difference. Keep reading to restore your clothes effortlessly and bring them back to life.

item.title: Make your own pichkari at home with everyday items for Holi fun
item.description: Make Holi more playful with easy DIY water guns crafted from daily materials, offering safe, affordable and creative fun for children and families at home.

item.title: India vs West Indies, T20 World Cup: What is India’s record at Eden Gardens in T20Is?
item.description: India will lock horns with West Indies in a must-win Super Eight clash at the Eden Gardens in Kolkata on Sunday. Here is a look at India’s record in T20Is at the venue.

item.title: Zoom introduces Virtual Agent 3.0 for customer support
item.description: Zoom has introduced Virtual Agent 3.0 for automating customer service interactions. The tech is focused on resolving customer issues.

item.title: Indian IT stocks brace for impact as AI concerns drive US market downturn
item.description: Concerns over AI’s impact hit the US tech stocks on Friday. There was 5% drop in Infosys ADRs and 3.5% for Wipro. Indian IT giants such as Infosys, Wipro, TCS, and HCL Tech are expected to be in focus on March 2, 2026.

item.title: Groww expands into AI-powered platform for traders
item.description: Groww has rolled out new wealth platforms, AI research tools, listed bonds and a professional trading system as it looks to widen its investor base and move beyond mutual funds and stock investing.

item.title: Maharashtra: 15 dead, several injured after powerful blast at ammunition manufacturing factory in Nagpur
item.description: An early morning blast at an explosives manufacturing factory in Nagpur led to the death of 15 people and left at least 18 others badly injured. The police team and a team of fire brigade reached the spot immediately and began rescue operations. Most of the victims were women.

item.title: ‘Paribartan Yatra’: Bengal BJP’s 1 crore outreach goal with Nitin Nabin, JP Nadda to join ‘yatra’ ahead of polls
item.description: The ‘Paribartan Yatra’ will cover 5,000 km with the BJP aiming to reach out to the common public and to test its organisational strength. The saffron party’s grassroots machinery will have a huge role to play to fulfill the goal of converting booth-level groundwork into visible street mobilisation.

item.title: Anthropic’s Claude surpasses ChatGPT in US app store rankings
item.description: Anthropic’s AI assistant Claude has climbed to No. 1 on Apple’s US free app chart after weeks of steady growth. The app overtook ChatGPT and Gemini as user sign-ups and subscriptions surged.
